about_the_game:
Share-o-matic TURBO is the DLC that allows you to enjoy the full experience of Share-o-matic, removing all limitations of the free version.

Send unlimited files to your recipient, and automatically unlock all extra features as they are released!

Share-o-matic TURBO is not a subscription: you purchase it once and it is yours forever!
